name: Najam Institute Foundation
mission: Our mission at Najam Institute Foundation goes beyond just providing aid for humanitarian efforts. We are devoted to helping those in need by offering them the essential resources and support necessary for them to lead a more prosperous life. We believe that everyone deserves the opportunity for a brighter future.
theoryOfChange: We believe that everyone deserves the opportunity for a brighter future.
